findings.title: Fragile origin path equality check
findings.message: load() compares Module.Dir to root for every package. If a package sits in a nested module or the module dir differs by symlink or case (macOS/Windows), the check fails spuriously. On Windows, EvalSymlinks can also return differently-cased or short-name paths, so the CI Windows job may fail.
findings.suggestion: Compare with os.SameFile on os.Stat results, or normalise both paths consistently.

findings.title: Constraint fingerprint uses Underlying and misses named constraint changes
findings.message: genericConstraintEdits only compares type parameters of top-level funcs and types. Changes in generic methods on non-generic types do not apply, but more importantly, a type that changes from non-generic to generic (or the reverse) is flagged, while a Func vs TypeName kind change gives params==nil on one side. fingerprint(nil) calls list.Len() on a nil *TypeParamList which is safe, but constraint fingerprints use Underlying(), so changes in a named constraint that keeps the same underlying type are missed.
findings.suggestion: Fingerprint the constraint without Underlying() (types.TypeString of the Constraint itself) and also compare the parameter count.
